name: Stepper
description: Multi-step flow indicator: ordered list, aria-current step, text state for complete/current/upcoming.
designIntent: Wizards need orientation: where am I, what is done, what is next. A stepper built on an ordered list keeps the sequence structural and announces state in text, not just color.

props.name: current
props.description: Zero-based index of the active step.

examples.title: Onboarding wizard
examples.code:
<Stepper
  current={step}
  steps={[{ label: 'Account' }, { label: 'Studio details' }, { label: 'Invite team' }, { label: 'Review' }]}
/>
examples.description: Current step is announced; completed steps show a check.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use it for progress percentage
antiPatterns.explanation: Use Progress for measurable 0-100 progress; Stepper is discrete stages.
antiPatterns.example:
// Avoid: 7 steps for an upload
// Prefer: <Progress value={42} />

accessibility.implementation: Ordered list with aria-current=step and sr-only state text
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep step labels short and parallel

compositionRules.relationship: One Form (or Form step) per Stepper stage
